description: Java class ContactHelper providing methods to access and format contact mechanisms and credit card info within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ContactHelper
classes.description: Utility class for retrieving and formatting contact mechanism data related to parties in OFBiz.

methods.name: getContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party, optionally including old records.

methods.name: getContactMechByType
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms of a specific type for a party.

methods.name: getContactMechByPurpose
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms with a specific purpose for a party.

methods.name: getContactMech
methods.description: Core method to retrieve contact mechanisms based on purpose and type filters.

methods.name: formatCreditCard
methods.description: Formats credit card information into a string with card type, last four digits, and expiry date.
